archive_dialog.title: Archive this squad?
archive_dialog.description: "{{name}}" will be archived. Issues currently assigned to this squad will be transferred to its leader. This can't be undone — create a new squad if you need the routing back.

description_dialog.title: Edit description
description_dialog.responsibility_placeholder: What is this squad responsible for?

discard_changes_dialog.title: Discard unsaved changes?
discard_changes_dialog.description: You have unsaved changes on this tab. Switching tabs will discard them.

instructions_tab.description: The leader reads these instructions whenever it works on an issue assigned to this squad.
instructions_tab.placeholder: e.g. Always start by writing a failing test. Prefer small, atomic commits.

canvas.layout_note: Drag positions or the background to arrange the view. Layout does not change execution.
canvas.legend: Solid: needs/forward. Dashed: stage inference. Dotted: materials. Gate links follow the state declaration.
canvas.title: Title
canvas.paths: Exact output paths, one per line
canvas.delete_help: These references will be removed. No connection will be added across the deleted node or gate.
canvas.convert_help: This writes explicit needs for the listed targets, preserving their other dependencies. needs also determines their default material sources. Existing dependencies will never be discarded.
canvas.stale: This source cannot be mapped safely. The last available diagram is read-only and must not overwrite the current YAML.
canvas.capability: This server capability is not understood; canvas changes are disabled.
canvas.historical: Historical version — read-only. Open the current definition to edit.
canvas.role_unavailable: This role is no longer in the squad. Select a current role or the leader.
canvas.source_changed: The source changed. Review it before applying this operation.

errors.parse: The YAML could not be parsed.
errors.mapping: This structure cannot be edited safely on the canvas. Use YAML to preserve it.
errors.kind: This dialect is not supported for canvas editing.
errors.duplicate: This identifier or connection already exists.
errors.missing: The referenced node or connection is unavailable.
errors.retry: Retries must be an integer from 0 to 10.
errors.paths: Use exact relative output paths without globs or parent traversal.
errors.manual: Manual gates do not execute roles, retries or output files.
errors.inferred: Review the change from stage inference to explicit needs.
errors.material_conflict: needs and dependencies cannot coexist. Edit YAML to choose the material policy; existing materials were kept.
errors.direction: Flow dependencies must use the same or an earlier stage; materials must use an earlier stage.
errors.cycle: This connection would create a self-loop or dependency cycle.
errors.branch: Hermes currently supports one forward chain without branches or joins.
errors.gate: A Hermes gate belongs to one state. Edit or delete that gate instead of writing a virtual state or gate link.

v17.port_help: Drag ports to connect, or activate a port to choose endpoints with the keyboard or touch.
